asserts: these signed objects were present in the append-only log in this order at export time
each object's Ed25519 signature verifies against its issuer/approver did:key
the findings were produced by re-running the public verification recompute over every receipt in the range at export time, and findings.json hashes to the findings_sha256 in this signed manifest

contents.what: this signed manifest (exporter, range, chain state, findings hash, asserts / does-not-assert)
the log entries in range, JCS-canonical, in chain order
deterministic verification summary over the range (verdict counts, non-VALID receipts named, approval closure states, countersignature/dispute counts)
the fleet key registry (label -> did:key) the signatures verify against
the published issuer registry (classes, statuses, caps) at export time
the signed chain checkpoints, so the entries' chain head can be anchored independently of this pack

does_not_assert: that the action was wise, safe, or a good idea
that the action was authorized by any party other than the named approver (when an approval is bound)
that args_public is complete for receipts where it is absent — absent args are proven by hash only, on disclosure by a holder
that the artifact at artifact_url still exists or is unchanged beyond its result_hash at issuance time
the real-world identity behind a did:key beyond its registry entry
